title: Cargo Manifest — the honest copy
author: Jasper Quell
notes: Bible 7.2: Quell's honest copy, hidden in his desk; the true crate contents are canon (11.3: 40 horn-coins, 3 carved stones, 1 name-stone).

pages.text:
Kept for my own safety. If it comes to it, I never knew.

Horn-coin, 40 pcs. Carved stone (ox-headed), 3. Name-stone, 1 — do NOT let the men see this one.
